events.title: Fort Sumter
events.text: Confederate batteries in Charleston harbour have forced the surrender of Fort Sumter. President Lincoln must answer the rebellion.

options.text: Call for 75,000 volunteers to put down the rebellion
Seek a compromise and let the cotton states go

events.title: The Upper South secedes
events.text: Lincoln's call for troops to coerce the seceded states has turned Virginia, Arkansas, Tennessee and North Carolina against the Union. Their conventions vote to join the Confederacy.

options.text: Welcome Virginia, Arkansas, Tennessee and North Carolina
The upper South stays loyal to Washington

events.title: The Trent Affair
events.text: A Union warship has stopped the British mail packet Trent and seized the Confederate envoys Mason and Slidell. London is furious and sends troops to Canada.

options.text: Demand the envoys' release; accept Seward's climbdown
Recognise the Confederacy and break the blockade

events.title: The Emancipation Proclamation
events.text: After Antietam, Lincoln can declare free all slaves in the areas still in rebellion and open the Union army to Black soldiers, turning the war into a war against slavery.

events.title: Gettysburg and Vicksburg
events.text: In the first days of July Lee's invasion of the North is broken at Gettysburg and Vicksburg falls, giving the Union the Mississippi.

options.text: Fall back to Virginia and fight on
Gamble on another invasion of the North

events.title: Appomattox Court House
events.text: Richmond has fallen and Lee's army, cut off and starving, asks for terms. The Confederacy is collapsing.

options.text: Accept Lee's surrender and restore the Union
Negotiate a separate peace with Richmond

events.title: The Alaska Purchase
events.text: Russian America is costly and indefensible against Britain. Washington offers $7.2 million for it.

options.text: Sell Alaska to the United States

events.title: Juárez suspends the foreign debt
events.text: The treasury is empty after the Reform War. President Juárez proposes to suspend payments on the debts owed to Britain, France and Spain for two years.

options.text: Suspend payments on the foreign debt

events.title: Intervention in Mexico
events.text: Mexico has defaulted. Napoleon III sees a chance to found a Latin, Catholic empire in the Americas while the United States is at war with itself.

options.text: Land at Veracruz and march on Mexico City

events.title: A crown for Maximilian
events.text: French troops are fighting in Mexico. Conservative notables offer the throne of a Mexican Empire to Archduke Maximilian of Austria.

options.text: Install Maximilian as Emperor of Mexico

events.title: The Second Mexican Empire
events.text: Maximilian and Carlota have landed at Veracruz. The new empire depends on French bayonets against the republicans of Juárez.

options.text: Ally with France against the Republic

events.title: France leaves Mexico
events.text: With the American Civil War over, Washington demands that French troops leave Mexico, and Prussia's rise makes them needed at home.

events.title: Querétaro
events.text: Without French troops the empire is collapsing. Maximilian is besieged at Querétaro.

options.text: Execute Maximilian and restore the Republic

events.title: The January Uprising
events.text: Polish insurgents have risen against conscription into the Russian army. Partisan bands fight across Congress Poland and Lithuania.

options.text: Restore the Kingdom of Poland's autonomy

events.title: The November Constitution
events.text: Copenhagen proposes a common constitution for Denmark and Schleswig, defying the German Confederation.

events.title: The Second Schleswig War
events.text: Denmark has bound Schleswig to the kingdom. Bismarck proposes that Prussia and Austria act together.

options.text: Leave it to the Federal Diet

events.title: Austria marches on Jutland
events.text: Prussia is at war with Denmark over the Elbe duchies. Vienna cannot let Berlin lead Germany alone.

events.title: The Treaty of Vienna
events.text: Denmark is beaten. It can be made to give up Schleswig, Holstein and Lauenburg.

events.title: The Seven Weeks' War
events.text: Bismarck has secured Italy's alliance and quarrels with Vienna over Holstein. Moltke is ready to strike.

options.text: Leave the Confederation and declare war on Austria

events.title: The Third War of Independence
events.text: Prussia is at war with Austria. The alliance promises Italy Venetia.

events.title: The Peace of Prague
events.text: Königgrätz has decided the war. Austria must leave German affairs to Prussia, and Hanover, which fought for Austria, lies at Prussia's mercy.

options.text: Annex Hanover and exclude Austria from Germany

events.title: The cession of Venetia
events.text: Defeated by Prussia, Austria must give Venetia up, by way of Napoleon III, to Italy. The German Confederation is dissolved.

events.title: The North German Confederation
events.text: Prussia annexes Hesse-Kassel, Nassau and Frankfurt and binds the states north of the Main into a federation under its king.

options.text: Annex the Hessian states and found the Confederation

events.title: Saxony joins the Confederation
events.text: Saxony fought for Austria in 1866 but is spared annexation; its army and foreign policy pass to the Confederation.

options.text: Bring Saxony and the Thuringian duchies into the Confederation

events.title: The Compromise of 1867
events.text: Defeat has shaken the monarchy. Hungarian leaders offer to back the dynasty in return for their own government.

events.title: The Ems Dispatch
events.text: Bismarck has published an edited account of the King's meeting with the French ambassador at Ems. Paris feels insulted.

events.title: The South German alliances
events.text: France has declared war on Prussia. The secret alliances of 1866 bind the southern German states to Berlin.

events.title: Sedan
events.text: The Emperor has surrendered with his army at Sedan. In Paris the crowd proclaims a republic.

events.title: The German Empire
events.text: Victorious over France, the German princes offer King Wilhelm the imperial crown in the Hall of Mirrors at Versailles.

events.title: Württemberg and Baden enter the Empire
events.text: The southwestern kingdoms join the new German Empire.

options.text: Welcome Württemberg and Baden into the Empire

events.title: The Treaty of Frankfurt
events.text: Paris has capitulated. France can be made to pay an indemnity of five billion francs and give up Alsace and northern Lorraine.

events.title: The capture of Rome
events.text: The French garrison has gone home to fight Prussia. Rome, the last of the Papal States, lies open.

events.title: Self-Strengthening
events.text: After the burning of the Summer Palace, Prince Gong founds the Zongli Yamen and urges buying Western arms and ships.

options.text: Rely on the Banners and the Green Standard

events.title: The fall of Nanjing
events.text: Zeng Guofan's Xiang Army has encircled the Heavenly Capital. The Heavenly King is dead.

events.title: The Meiji Restoration
events.text: Satsuma and Chōshū have seized the palace in Kyoto and declared imperial rule restored. The shogunate must yield or fight.

events.title: The Treaty of Saigon
events.text: French and Spanish forces hold Saigon and the delta. Hue can buy peace by ceding three southern provinces.

options.text: Cede Biên Hòa, Gia Định and Định Tường

events.title: Canadian Confederation
events.text: Delegates from Canada, Nova Scotia and New Brunswick have agreed a federal union. Parliament is asked to pass the British North America Act.

options.text: Pass the British North America Act

events.title: The Dominion of Canada
events.text: On 1 July 1867 Canada, Nova Scotia and New Brunswick become one Dominion.

events.title: Rupert's Land and British Columbia
events.text: The Hudson's Bay Company sells Rupert's Land to Canada, and British Columbia agrees to join on the promise of a railway.

options.text: Keep the Company's lands under the Crown

events.title: The Suez Canal
events.text: De Lesseps' canal joining the Mediterranean and the Red Sea is ready. Khedive Ismail plans a magnificent opening.

options.text: Open the canal with great ceremony

events.title: Pavón
events.text: Fighting between Buenos Aires and the Confederation has resumed. At Pavón Urquiza leaves the field to Mitre, and the Confederation's government dissolves.

options.text: Unite the provinces under Buenos Aires

events.title: The Paraguayan War
events.text: Brazil has intervened in Uruguay. López fears for the balance of the River Plate and Paraguay's large army is ready.

options.text: Seize the Marqués de Olinda and invade Mato Grosso

events.title: The Treaty of the Triple Alliance
events.text: Paraguayan troops have crossed Argentine territory to reach Brazil. Buenos Aires joins Rio de Janeiro (with Flores' Uruguay) against López.
